metadata.dedup_method: Itemized Schedule E rows. Memo subtotals dropped. Within each filing chain only the latest version of a transaction is kept (FEC most_recent flag plus previous_file_number on amendments). For each committee, periodic-report rows (non-notice) stand up to the latest processed periodic coverage end date, and 24/48-hour notices count only after it. If a committee has periodic rows but no coverage end date can be matched, notices are matched one for one to periodic rows on (committee, candidate, support/oppose, amount, date, payee) and the committee is listed as approximate.
